item.title: IT Admin I - Engineering
item.description:
Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

Zeitview is looking for a Junior IT Engineer to join our Corporate IT team in Bangalore India, APAC. In this role, you'll be the

friendly, first line of support for Zeitview employees while building the foundational skills to grow into a broader systems

and infrastructure role. You'll spend your days keeping our people productive — setting up laptops, resolving helpdesk

tickets, and troubleshooting Wi-Fi and VPN issues — while working alongside senior engineers on the servers, cloud

systems, and network infrastructure that keep Zeitview running. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their IT

career who wants hands-on experience across the full stack of corporate technology, with mentorship and a clear growth path.

 

  • Serve as the first point of contact for employee IT support, triaging and resolving helpdesk tickets covering hardware, software, accounts, and connectivity issues.
  • Set up, image, and deploy laptops and peripherals for new hires; manage IT onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning and deprovisioning.
  • Provide day-to-day desktop and end-user support for Windows, macOS, and standard office/SaaS applications, both in-office and for remote employees.

item.title: Sales Manager
item.description:
Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

Sales Manager – India

Employment Type: 12-Month Contract
Location: India
Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry Focus: Utilities, Oil & Gas, Energy & Infrastructure, Solar
Experience: 5-8 years
Reporting To: Director, APAC Sales

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sales Manager to join our team on a 12-month contract and lead business development and sales activities across various energy sectors in India.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic customer relationships, managing the sales pipeline, and driving revenue growth across key accounts. This role requires a strong understanding of the local energy market, including power generation and transmission, electricity distribution, renewable energy, oil & gas exploration and production, refining, petrochemicals, pipelines, LNG, and associated infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling industrial technology, engineering solutions, equipment, services, digital solutions, automation, or other B2B offerings
